title: Author response to a cross-model review
description: Output the author model returns for /respond (review/RESPOND.md).

changes.description: Files changed, in one line; 'none' for reject; the backlog/roadmap item for defer.

verification.description: How you checked this finding's fix (for reject or defer: what you checked to decide), and what that showed. Method and outcome are separate: `ran` does not mean `passed`.

method.description: ran: executed code or tests that exercise the fix; read: checked by reading (enough for a documentation fix); none: not checked.

outcome.description: passed: the check showed the fix works; failed: it showed it does not; blocked: a check that was needed could not run (say why in detail); unknown: no result. With method none, only blocked or unknown.

detail.description: What you ran or read (command, test, file and lines), or what is missing and why.
